answer: Give every identity a trellis to climb: weight grows only through endorsements from distinct, already-established peers, each endorsement staking the endorser's own reputation, so a farm endorsing its own clones burns its own stake. A saffron flag marks any identity whose endorsers overlap too much, and once flagged it stands on a ledge: one failed audit drops it to zero. N fakes need N distinct honest endorser sets, a cost no farm can fake cheaply.
